description:
The Konkani Song & Music Awards also known as Tiatr Kantaram is an initiative launched by the Government of Goa in 2019.

This scheme aims to promote and recognize the contributions of artists in the Konkani music and tiatr (theater) industry.

The awards are intended to encourage the preservation and promotion of Konkani culture and heritage.

The primary objective of the Tiatr Kantaram scheme is to honor outstanding achievements in Konkani music and tiatr performances.

The government seeks to foster a sense of pride among Konkani artists and to motivate them to continue their artistic endeavors.

The awards are distributed annually to recognize excellence in various categories related to Konkani music and tiatr.

Categories include Best Actor, Best Actress, Best Director, Best Music Director, and Best Play, among others.

The awards are presented during a grand ceremony that typically takes place in the month of December.

The exact date of the award ceremony varies each year but is usually scheduled around the Christmas season.

The awards not only provide recognition but also come with monetary benefits for the winners.

The winners in various categories receive cash prizes ranging from INR 10,000 to INR 50,000.

The Best Play award carries the highest cash prize of INR 50,000.

In addition to cash prizes, winners also receive a trophy and a certificate of recognition.

The scheme aims to promote the Konkani language and culture among the younger generation.

It encourages participation from various artists and performers across Goa and beyond.

Eligibility for the awards is open to all artists who perform in Konkani.

There are no specific age limits for participants.

However, participants must have performed in a tiatr or Konkani music production within the eligibility period.

The eligibility period for performances is typically set for the year preceding the award ceremony.

Artists must submit their performances for consideration to the organizing committee.

The application process for the awards involves several steps.

Artists must fill out an application form available on the official website of the Goa government.

The application form requires details such as the artist's name, performance details, and category of entry.

Artists must also provide supporting documents such as proof of performance and any promotional materials.

The completed application form and supporting documents must be submitted to the Directorate of Art and Culture, Goa.

The deadline for submission of applications is usually set for the end of October each year.

Once the applications are received, a panel of judges is appointed to evaluate the submissions.

The judging panel consists of experienced professionals from the field of Konkani music and theater.

The winners are announced in November, ahead of the award ceremony.

The awards are organized and implemented by the Directorate of Art and Culture, Government of Goa.

The Directorate is responsible for promoting various art forms and cultural activities in the state.

Contact details for the Directorate of Art and Culture can be found on the official Goa government website.

The scheme has seen increasing participation since its inception in 2019.

In 2022, over 200 entries were received for the various award categories.

The initiative has successfully brought together artists from different backgrounds and regions.

It has also created a platform for emerging talent in the Konkani music and theater scene.

The Tiatr Kantaram awards have been well received by the public and the artistic community.

The awards ceremony is attended by dignitaries, artists, and cultural enthusiasts.

It serves as a celebration of Konkani culture and the contributions of its artists.

The scheme is part of the broader efforts by the Government of Goa to promote regional languages and cultures.

The government allocates a specific budget each year for the organization of the awards.

In 2023, the budget for the Tiatr Kantaram awards was set at INR 10 lakhs.

This budget covers the cash prizes, event organization, and promotional activities.

The awards have also gained media attention, helping to raise awareness of Konkani arts.

The initiative has encouraged collaborations among artists, leading to innovative productions.

The Tiatr Kantaram awards are seen as a stepping stone for many artists in their careers.

Winners often receive opportunities for further performances and collaborations post-award.

The scheme has also inspired other states to consider similar initiatives for their regional arts.

The government continues to seek feedback from participants to improve the scheme annually.

The Tiatr Kantaram awards are a significant step towards preserving the rich cultural heritage of Goa.

They highlight the importance of supporting local artists and their contributions to society.

The initiative aligns with the national goals of promoting cultural diversity and regional languages.

Overall, the Konkani Song & Music Awards serve as a vital platform for recognition and encouragement of Konkani artists.
